narrative.overview: A compact white calendar workspace where twelve months make the full-year planning job visible. Black typography carries the interface; orange public holidays and pale-blue leave ranges explain the calendar without decorative theming. The map is flat at rest, with a fixed desktop details rail and native mobile dialog for the active break.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces and black default typography
Orange holidays and pale-blue leave ranges
Fixed desktop details panel and native mobile dialog

rules.name: Meaningful Colour
rules.body: Every non-neutral colour must explain a calendar state; accents do not decorate the chrome.

rules.name: Small Editorial
rules.body: Use Newsreader for product and month headings only; dates, switches, caveats, and source links stay in Geist.

rules.name: Flat Workspace
rules.body: Keep the year map visually quiet; use elevation only for open, active, or layered states.

dos: Make the twelve-month year wall primary
Keep ordinary text and controls black or charcoal
Reserve colour for documented calendar meanings
Keep the recommendation available without hover
donts: Do not add dark backgrounds, airport motifs, gradients, or decorative travel imagery
Do not use plum or multiple coloured toggle treatments as interface chrome
Do not add borders or shadows to every month card
Do not ship the review comps as page imagery
